object.name: session_manager
object.description: Privileged interface for registering and deregistering unsafe sessions. Only accessible to root clients. Clients must not issue another create_session request on the same object before the previous request completes.

c2s.name: create_session

description.summary: [unsafe: can leak the session] register a session without an owning object

c2s.description: Registers a session and replies on this object with session_id and env variables. Any env variables sent before create_session are attached to the created session. The caller must pair it with destroy_session or the session's resources (cgroup, runtime directory) leak.

arg.name: vt
arg.summary: virtual terminal number, 0 if the session is not bound to a VT

arg.name: is_local
arg.summary: non-zero if local, zero if remote

arg.name: remote_host
arg.summary: remote host, empty for local sessions

description.summary: unsafe session created, initial field dump complete

c2s.name: destroy_session

description.summary: [unsafe: paired with create_session] deregister a session by id

c2s.description: Deregisters the session identified by session_id. An unpaired create_session leaks the session's resources.

c2s.name: env

description.summary: stage an environment variable for the next created session

c2s.description: Optional. May be sent multiple times before create_session.

value.name: user
value.summary: interactive login session owned by a user

value.name: greeter
value.summary: login prompt or display manager session

value.name: lock_screen
value.summary: screen locker session associated with an existing login

value.name: background
value.summary: non-interactive user session without an attached seat or VT

value.name: background_light
value.summary: lightweight background session excluded from idle shutdown accounting

value.name: manager_early
value.summary: early per-user service manager session created before a regular login
